parameters.name: ClusterId
parameters.description:
The cluster ID.

You can call the [ListClusters](~~87116~~) operation to query the cluster ID.

parameters.name: DeploymentSetId
parameters.description: The deployment set ID. You can obtain the deployment set ID by calling the [DescribeDeploymentSets](~~91313~~) operation. Only the deployment sets that use low latency policy are supported.

parameters.name: NetworkInterfaceTrafficMode
parameters.description:
The communication mode of the elastic network interface (ENI). Valid values:

*   Standard: uses the TCP communication mode.
*   HighPerformance: uses the remote direct memory access (RDMA) communication mode with Elastic RDMA Interface (ERI) enabled.

parameters.name: QueueName
parameters.description: The name of the queue. The name must be 1 to 63 characters in length and start with a letter. It can contain letters, digits, and underscores (\_).

parameters.name: UseESS
parameters.description: Specifies whether to use scaling groups of Auto Scaling.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ehpc add-queue --cluster-id ehpc-hz-FYUr320000 --queue-name test1 --network-interface-traffic-mode Standard --deployment-set-id ds-bp1frxuzdg87zh4pzq0000 --use-ess false --api-version 2018-04-12 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun ehpc AddQueue --region cn-hangzhou --DeploymentSetId 'ds-bp1frxuzdg87zh4pzq0000' --UseESS false --NetworkInterfaceTrafficMode Standard --ClusterId 'ehpc-hz-FYUr320000' --QueueName test1
